v1.note: P is one design four times: a tapered lamp on the left with brass or steel caps, a dark glass panel of heat/blob sliders and four swatches on the right, and a glowing pink/orange palette. Q ranges widely: a squat bell jar with a bottom dock, a giant globe, a lamp in a room scene with a shelf and plant, and a full-width bottle with a toggle and time controls. R mostly repeats the tall rocket-style lamp, but it varies the layout (centred dock, side panel) and one lamp is a round bulb shape.

v2.note: P mixes a rocket lamp, a teardrop, a spherical globe on a stand and a squat amber bell, with different layouts (side panel, bottom bar, tiny console) and moods. Q has two near-identical tall rocket lamps plus one bulbous lamp and one panel variant, so shape and layout repeat more. R is one tapered lamp with a side control card four times, varying mainly cap and base metal and wax colour.

v3.note: P has one bulbous lamp (P1) but P2-P4 are the same tall rocket-shaped metallic lamp with blurry blobs and a control panel or bar; Q is four near-identical tapered cone lamps with a brass or chrome cap, a right-hand glass panel with sliders and swatches, differing mainly in wax colour and a pixelated render in Q2; R varies the silhouette (squat amber bulb, round globe, tall tapered stage-lit lamp, framed bulb-shaped lamp), the palette, the scene (shelf with props, a floor, a framed stage) and the control layout (bottom bar vs side panel).

v1.note: P is one dark rounded calculator with an orange operator column and a flat black display, four times with only minor color tweaks. Q mixes two retro 7-segment LCD skeuo takes with a light neumorphic one and a dark glass one (with a full-width equals), and R mixes cream, dark blue outline, sage, and another LCD with a wide equals; both repeat the 4x5 grid and the LCD or cream archetype once.

v2.note: P and Q each mix a dark glass or flat dark take, a cream/light take and an LCD retro take, but P has two near-duplicate LCD calculators (P2/P4) and Q has two similar cream ones (Q1/Q4), with Q varying key layout more (wide 0, wide =, 5-column LCD). R is the same dark iOS-style calculator four times with only accent colour tweaks.

v3.note: Q is one dark calculator with orange keys and a 4x5 grid made four times, differing only in grey and orange tints. P and R each have one 7-segment LCD (P1, R1/R3 are near-twins in R) plus light and dark flat takes, with some key-layout changes (wide 0, wide = row, ± position); R has two near-duplicate LCD skeuomorphs and P has two similar cream/orange flat ones, so they come out about equal.
